assumptions: Used claim_latest (one latest row per claim) and approved claims only.

cases.question: How many visits were there in Indonesia in October 2026?

output.answer: There were 322 approved visits in Indonesia in October 2026.
sql: SELECT count(*) AS approved_visit_count FROM claim_latest WHERE is_approved AND country_code = 'ID' AND visit_date >= DATE '2026-10-01' AND visit_date <= DATE '2026-10-31' AND visit_date <= DATE '2026-11-30'
assumptions: Visits are counted as approved claims, using the latest claim version; one claim represents one visit.
Indonesia is identified by the provider country code ID.
The visit-date window is October 1–31, 2026, inclusive, with visits after the as-of date excluded.
Latest versions are used even when loaded after the as-of date.

cases.question: What is the rejection rate by provider type last quarter?

output.answer:
Rejection rate by provider type for last quarter (2026-07-01 through 2026-09-30):

| Provider type | Total claims | Rejected claims | Rejection rate |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Dental | 325 | 57 | 17.54% |
| GP | 3,245 | 565 | 17.41% |
| Hospital | 290 | 49 | 16.90% |
| Specialist | 850 | 139 | 16.35% |
| Unknown | 2,777 | 450 | 16.20% |
sql: SELECT provider_type, count(*) AS total_claims, count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_rejected) AS rejected_claims, round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_rejected) / NULLIF(count(*), 0), 2) AS rejection_rate_pct FROM claim_latest WHERE visit_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-07-01' AND DATE '2026-09-30' AND visit_date <= DATE '2026-11-30' GROUP BY provider_type ORDER BY provider_type
assumptions: Used claim_latest (one latest-version row per claim).
Rejection rate is rejected claims divided by all claims in the period, including approved, rejected, and voided statuses; rejected status is is_rejected.
Applied the last-quarter visit_date window inclusively and excluded visit dates after 2026-11-30.
Kept Unknown provider type as a separate group.
A claim may be both rejected and approved.

cases.question: How many claims have a visit date in the future?

output.answer: 371 claims have a visit date after 2026-11-30.
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS claims_with_future_visit_date FROM claim_latest WHERE visit_date > DATE '2026-11-30'
assumptions: Counted one row per claim from claim_latest (the latest loaded version).
“Future” means visit_date later than the as-of date, 2026-11-30; no approved-only filter was applied because this asks about all claims.
Claims with visit dates after the as-of date are data errors and are counted here rather than excluded.
